# WO-2026-08-13-15 — Lane J: the whole journey, over the real photograph, in one run

**Warwick's clause 7, verbatim, and it is the whole point of this order:** *"The whole journey is demonstrated as a working user experience, **not inferred from unit tests, fixtures or disconnected components**."*

**What is already true, and is NOT what he asked for.** Lane G (`2cc5ac1`) built a genuine production caller — `runPipeline.planWithDecisions` now persists all four provenance kinds — and proved it at **1091/1091/0 skipped**, including on a pristine CRLF checkout. But it said so plainly in its own return: *"Was the real production event exercised? **NO**."* The model consult was faked and the durable store was `fakePg`. **A chain of individually-proven links is not a proven chain.**

## Two grants you have not had before — read them carefully

**1. THE PHOTOGRAPH IS NOW COMMITTED.** `services/asdair/pipeline/testdata/known-list/mum-list-2026-08-11.jpg`, **sha256 `89f33073296b4808f544b1f6111f10c723e532106f339d94cdae90633de80a16`**. Verified equal to the `fingerprint` on live `asdair.shop_source_image` for shop 26 — **this is the photograph production actually ingested**, not a lookalike. It previously lived only in the secrets store, which is why every prior order faked its input. **You can now open it directly. Nothing under `C:\.fusion247\` is in your scope.**

**2. `network: gateway-vision-only` and `credential_scope: consume-env-file-by-path-never-open`**, declared on the field with authority recorded. **The permitted shape is exact:** pass the env file to `node --env-file=<path>` so the *runtime* loads it. **You never open, read, print, echo or commit that file, and no connection string or key may appear in anything you author.** `handoffCli.test.js:379` already fails the suite on a literal connection string — that control is your friend here.

Gateway confirmed reachable, serving **9 models including `gpt-5.6-terra`** (vision-capable).

## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — ONE CONTINUOUS RUN, NO FIXTURE STANDING IN FOR THE STEP BEFORE IT.** A single command takes the committed photograph → **real grounded vision call** → reconciliation → provenance persistence → final brand-sorted list → browser-handoff payload, against the disposable Postgres. **The defining test: no step may be handed data a fixture supplied on behalf of the previous step.** If any link still needs a stub, that link is the finding and you say so rather than bridging it.

**AC2 — ALL FOUR PROVENANCE KINDS PERSIST FROM THIS RUN.** Read back from Postgres, **scoped to the shop this run creates** — the cluster is shared and moved under Lane G mid-build (PHOTO rows went 9→17 from another lane). PHOTO rows must cite a region of **this run's own** photograph.

**AC3 — THE RESULT RECONCILES, AND YOU REPORT WHAT IT ACTUALLY IS.** Report observed / accounted / established / resolved / routed / skipped, product count and item count. **⚠️ The established figures over this photograph are 47/47, 39 established, 30 resolved, 9 routed, 39 products / 53 items — but those came from THREE frozen readings. This is ONE live reading, and it may legitimately differ.** **Do NOT tune anything to reach those numbers.** Report what the run produced and how it compares. *A number you engineered to match is worth less than a number that honestly differs.*

**AC4 — IT REACHES THE BROWSER STAGE.** The run produces a browser-handoff payload, **brand-sorted**, with pack size carried as identity and never multiplied into a purchase quantity (Richmond 16 → **1 pack**). Counts in must equal counts out plus explicitly named exclusions. **Do NOT check out, pay, choose a slot, or touch a live ASDA session** — this produces the payload a runner would pick up, nothing further.

**AC5 — CORROBORATED, NEVER VERIFIED.** One live reading cannot corroborate itself. **If your run produces a single reading, no line may be labelled corroborated either** — say what support it actually has. Warwick's ruling binds every emitted artefact.

**AC6 — THE RESIDUAL GAP IS NAMED, NOT PAPERED OVER.** Live database, live Telegram and the real production trigger are **deliberately out of scope** — the production loop sends queued messages, and firing it would message Mum unprompted. **State in your return exactly which links are now real and which remain unexercised.** That sentence is what Veritas grades and what Warwick reads.

## Required evidence

- **The single command**, with its full output, and the run's own identifiers so it can be re-run.
- **Provenance rows read back by kind**, scoped to this run's shop.
- **The handoff payload**, with its counts and the brand ordering visible.
- `cd services/asdair/pipeline && node --test` with the DB env → **executed subtest count, pass/fail split, and SKIPPED count.** Lane G's baseline is **1091/1091/0**.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface <first-party paths>` → exit code AND coverage. **Additionally confirm no key or connection string reached any file you authored.**
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/asdair/pipeline` → report exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass

- `services/asdair/pipeline/planProvenance.js` and `runPipeline.js` `planWithDecisions` — **your own Lane G work; the production caller this run must exercise for real**
- `services/asdair/pipeline/deps.js:775` `interpretPhoto: realInterpretPhoto` — the production vision binding
- `services/asdair/pipeline/finalise/` — reconciliation, quantity settlement, the final list
- `services/asdair/handoff/readReconciled.js` (Lane F, `de8560b`, **a different branch** — read for its contract, do not import across branches)
- Disposable target: `postgresql://asdair_rw:test@127.0.0.1:55432/asdair_test`, owner `postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/asdair_test`

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

**⛔ VISION, OCR, PROMPTS, MODEL COMPARISON — PARKED BY WARWICK.** *"Do not reopen the eyesight architecture or start another vision research cycle unless genuinely new evidence disproves that result."* **You are exercising the vision path once as a link in the journey. You are not evaluating, tuning or improving it.** If this run reads the page differently from the frozen three, **that is a result to report, not a defect to chase** — and only *genuinely new evidence disproving 39/39* would reopen anything, which is Warwick's call and not yours.

**⛔ NO LIVE DATABASE. NO LIVE TELEGRAM. NO PRODUCTION TRIGGER.** The production loop `runtime.js` sends whatever is queued in the outbox — **firing it would message Mum unprompted.** That is an outward irreversible action affecting a third party and it is not in this order at any authority level.

**⛔ NO CHECKOUT, NO PAYMENT, NO SLOT, NO LIVE ASDA SESSION.**

Also out: `cockpit-api/**` · the Cockpit UI · `handoff/**` (Lane F's branch) · `db/**` · migration 020's `conname` guard (**Silas's, already recorded**) · the `execution_packet` producer that no lane owns.

## Sequencing

1. **READ-BACK and HOLD.** Restate the outcome, your plan, what this order fails to settle, and what looks wrong. **You have falsified six of my premises across four orders and every one improved the product.** This order asks for something nobody has attempted end-to-end, so I expect it to contain at least one thing I have not seen.
2. On acceptance: get **one** link real at a time and keep the chain honest — a run that stops halfway with an accurate account of where it stopped is a better result than one that completes by bridging a gap with a fixture.
3. Commit and push `build-015/b15-28-agentic-vision-prototype-v2`. **No PR, no merge, never `main`, never `git add -A`.**
4. Return: the command, the counts, the provenance by kind, the handoff payload, and — **in plain words — which links of the journey are now real and which are still not.**
